review.notes: Full review of an unchanged head. Every Check and formula of Layers 1-5 recomputed (adversarial table of 26 rows, including all 15 sampled targets and the headline theorems). 21 source locators read at the text (Meinrenken, Cannas da Silva, Bates-Lerman, Ortega-Ratiu, Alexandrino-Bettiol); the sampled sections 3.0d, 3.0e and 5.2-5.10 carry no locator (small correction C02). Cross-roadmap citations resolved on main and, for CotangentLagrangian, at its open revision. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with the two sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes neither theorem. The previous review's four small corrections and one format note are unrepaired and carried. Two misprints in Meinrenken's notes recorded.
